summary: TransCode Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release with updated Phase 1a clinical data for TTX-MC138 in relapsed/refractory advanced solid tumors, with data cutoff September 1, 2026. Among 14 efficacy-evaluable patients, 71.4% achieved stable disease, with disease control of 57.1% at Cycle 3 Day 1 and 35.7% at Cycle 6 Day 1; three patients remained progression-free at one year. No dose-limiting toxicities and the primary endpoint was met. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are stated. This is a routine clinical data update, not a special situation; watch for regulatory and financing developments.
